# OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER Annual Refresher – RCRA TSD Operations Training

> Annual 8-hour online refresher for hazardous waste treatment, storage and disposal facility (TSDF) workers, used to keep the initial OSHA 24-Hour HAZWOPER – RCRA TSD Operations certification valid. Aligned with OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120(p) and 29 CFR 1926.65(p). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Regulation: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120(p) (general industry) and 29 CFR 1926.65(p) (construction)
- Required: every 12 months under the HAZWOPER standard
- Prerequisite: initial 24-hour or 40-hour HAZWOPER training
- Duration: 8 hours; 7 modules, 44 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.8 CEU
- Price: $89.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Group formats (minimum 10): virtual instructor-led $299/person; client-site in-person $750/person; SCORM packages available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, any device; English and Spanish
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 12 months; plastic wallet card mailed within 2–3 weeks

## Who it is for
TSDF workers; EHS professionals in regulated industries; hazardous waste handlers and storage personnel; emergency response teams supporting hazmat incidents; construction and general industry workers under HAZWOPER.

## Modules
1. Regulatory Overview
2. Hazard Classification
3. Personal Protective Equipment
4. HAZWOPER Site Operations
5. Material Sampling and Analysis
6. Decontamination and Site Emergencies
7. EPA Cradle-to-Grave Program
